OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: Entity types the connector can be triggered on, plus every type it emits (Report, Indicator, Note) — OpenCTI drops unlisted types.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_AUTO.description: Whether the connector should run automatically when an entity is created or updated.

HUNTER_API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the Intel 471 Hunter API.

HUNTER_API_KEY.description: Intel 471 Hunter API key, sent as `Authorization: API-Key <key>`. Obtained separately from Verity471/Titan credentials.

HUNTER_UI_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the Hunter UI, used to build external references back to each hunt. Leave empty to omit those links.

HUNTER_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: HTTP timeout, in seconds, for calls to the Hunter API.

HUNTER_MAX_RESULTS_PER_QUERY.description: Maximum number of hunt packages retrieved per query.

HUNTER_CACHE_PATH.description: Path of the local `(hunt_uuid, last_updated)` cache. Keep this on a dedicated directory: mounting a volume over the connector's working directory shadows its code.

HUNTER_CACHE_TTL_HOURS.description: Lifetime, in hours, of a cache entry.

HUNTER_MAX_TLP.description: The maximal TLP of the entity being enriched.
